title: Canonical Asset Schema
description: Internal canonical asset representation across registries and targets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the asset (lowercase, dash-separated)

description.description: Short explanation of the asset's capability and purpose

version.description: Semantic version or upstream content hash

requiresSetup.description: Whether the asset requires external configuration (e.g. MCP server, API key)

platforms.description: Target AI ecosystems supported (e.g. copilot, cursor, claude, antigravity)

dependencies.description: Asset IDs required for this asset to function

capabilities.description: Functional capabilities provided (e.g. docker, azure, testing)

provides.description: Named outputs or context provided by the asset

tags.description: Keyword tags for categorization and search

content.description: Raw markdown or textual body of the asset
